name: Risen Energy Co.,Ltd.
summary: Risen Energy Co.,Ltd. provides solar modules in China. The company offers TOPCon and hyper-ion modules; C and BIPV and residential BIPV systems; quality control; micro, string, and hybrid inverters; and energy storage products, including residential, C and I, and utility scale energy storage, as well as modular ESS, energy storage inverter/PCS, and energy management system products. It is also involved in the construction, operation, and sale of photovoltaic power plants; energy storage stations; and photovoltaic and energy storage systems.
